versions.content: Events consumed over TCP Pdus of an ConsumedEvent- Group that are consumed over TCP are described by SoConIPduIdentifier s refer- enced by the iPduIdentifierTcp reference from the PduActivationRouting- Group that is aggregated in the role pduActivationRoutingGroup by the Con- sumedEventGroup .
